name: Sissy Squat
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, resting one hand lightly on a wall or sturdy chair for balance if desired.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet, brace your core, and squeeze your glutes to lock your hips and torso into one straight line.
Bend your knees forward while leaning your torso smoothly backward so your body lowers toward the floor in a straight diagonal from knees to shoulders.
Drive powerfully through the balls of your feet and quads to extend your knees back to the upright starting stance.
tips: Keep your hips extended in line with your torso instead of bending backward at the waist.
Start with a partial range of motion and build depth gradually as your knees and quads adapt.
